openaiSpec.name: image_editing_via_stable_diffusion_3

mode.description:
The editing mode to use. Choose based on the user's request:
- 'erase': Remove unwanted objects from the image (no prompt needed)
- 'search_and_replace': Find and replace objects in the image (requires prompt and search_prompt)
- 'search_and_recolor': Change the color of specific objects (requires prompt and select_prompt)
- 'remove_background': Remove the background, keeping only the foreground (no prompt needed)

prompt.description: For 'search_and_replace': What to replace the found object with. For 'search_and_recolor': The new color or color description. Not needed for 'erase' or 'remove_background' modes.

search_prompt.description: Only for 'search_and_replace' mode: Describes the object to find and replace in the image.

select_prompt.description: Only for 'search_and_recolor' mode: Describes the object to select for recoloring.

openaiSpec.description:
Edits images using Stability AI's editing capabilities. Supports 4 modes:

1. Erase: Removes unwanted objects from images
2. Search and Replace: Finds objects and replaces them with something else
3. Search and Recolor: Changes the color of specific objects
4. Remove Background: Removes the background, isolating the foreground

The AI should choose the appropriate mode based on the user's request. The image to edit will be automatically read from the user's attachments.

Important: after calling this function, the output images will be shown to the user automatically. You don't need to include the output image to the users again in your response to avoid duplicate images.
